poisson.variable: Hours per day with PM2.5 > 250 µg/m³ (hazardous)

binomial.note: Hours within a day are strongly autocorrelated, so independence fails: the observed distribution is far wider (U-shaped) than Binomial(24, p) predicts.

tests.name: One-sample z-test

tests.sample: 200 random hours from 2014, σ assumed known from the full dataset

tests.name: Two-sample t-test (Welch)
tests.sample: daily means: 522 weekend days vs 1304 weekdays

tests.name: Two-sample t-test (Welch)
tests.sample: daily means: 451 winter days vs 460 summer days

tests.name: Paired t-test

wind.factor: Dominant wind direction of the day

matrix.reject: Type I error (false positive), probability α
